systems_modeling_role: Selects a trajectory or scenario from many possible paths
review_warning: Initial conditions should include unit source uncertainty and baseline notes

analytical_role: Specifies behavior at the edge of a domain
systems_modeling_role: Controls flow reflection absorption exchange or constraint
review_warning: Boundary assumptions can dominate spatial model behavior

analytical_role: Defines the modeled time interval and horizon
systems_modeling_role: Limits how far a model can responsibly be projected
review_warning: Short-horizon models should not be treated as long-term forecasts

analytical_role: Defines the region network or domain included in the model
systems_modeling_role: Clarifies what is inside and outside the modeled system
review_warning: Excluded surroundings may still affect real-world behavior

analytical_role: Defines tested or plausible parameter ranges
review_warning: Using values outside tested ranges requires review

analytical_role: Defines what a model output can responsibly support
systems_modeling_role: Separates computation from interpretation and decision use
review_warning: Model results should not be used beyond documented scope
